summary: Slow SELECT query with multiple LEFT JOINs over large tables.
symptoms: High row examination count in EXPLAIN plan.
mechanism: Inefficient query plan due to suboptimal indexing and large table sizes.

facts.evidence: Profiling shows repeated 'Waiting for query cache lock'.
Post mentions ~10M rows in persons and ~40M rows in attributes.
Post lists existing indexes on attribute table.

facts.value: LEFT JOINs with filters on multiple attributes.

assumptions: The database schema and query structure are as described in the post.
The target database will be created from scratch for this reproduction.
The query cache lock delays are due to contention in the query cache.
unknowns: Exact MySQL version used in the original environment.
Whether the query cache was enabled during the original execution.
The hardware specifications of the original environment.
